brief.text: Closed-end funds represent nearly half of all cluster activity, spanning five separate funds led by BPRE with $32.8 million across three insiders. Fuller H B Co (FUL) recorded the highest buyer participation with eight individual insiders purchasing $1.12 million, followed by Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP) with six insiders totaling $1.66 million. However, Borr Drilling Ltd (BORR) dwarfed all other totals with a massive $57.1 million cluster buy across three insiders, while Rent the Runway (RENT) attracted $6.12 million in notable purchases split among three major entities.
